name: genealogy-platform
description: Genealogy Platform monorepo — SaaS + on-premise, privacy-first, contract-first.

scripts.format:check: pnpm run -r --parallel format:check && pnpm exec prettier --check --log-level=warn --ignore-unknown --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern ".github/**/*.{md,yaml,yml,json}" "*.{md,json,yaml,yml}" "docs/**/*.md" "config/**/*.yaml" ".kiro/**/*.md"
scripts.lint:root: pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:yaml && pnpm lint:openapi && pnpm lint:markdown && pnpm lint:ownership
scripts.check:java:format: node scripts/run-gradle.mjs spotlessApply 2>/dev/null || echo 'Spotless apply is staged for E1.6 (see gradle/conventions/java-conventions.gradle.kts)'
scripts.check:all: pnpm check:boundary && pnpm check:lockfile && pnpm check:gradle:lock && pnpm check:ownership && pnpm check:generated && pnpm lint:eslint && pnpm lint:yaml && pnpm lint:openapi && pnpm lint:protobuf && pnpm lint:helm && pnpm lint:markdown && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm check:java:format && pnpm check:java && pnpm check:java:test
scripts.ci:quality: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm check:java && pnpm check:boundary
scripts.ci:full: pnpm ci:quality && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:contract && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm lint:ownership && pnpm lint:generated && pnpm lint:helm && pnpm check:platform
